scope: Candidate game-motion kit. Source takes preserved; derived in-place loops and one-shots. C08 and B-REK43 only. Runtime transitions, contact IK, collision controller and props require visual acceptance.
backlog: Ranged weapon rigs / reloads / aim offsets
Paired combat and verified environmental hand contacts

publication.kind: static recorded motion with a browser game controller
publication.transport: Shared character meshes plus lossless compressed tracks; no browser inference. Reconstructed source-motion GLBs differ from original file bytes and use the displayed 1.9 m character scale.
publication.reviews: Browser origin-local. Export/import to transfer localhost feedback.
